platformFee.label: System usage fee: ¥440 per guest; not refunded if you cancel. Refunded if the restaurant cancels.
quotes: Tabelog charges a system usage fee of JPY 440 per person* at the time of reservation.
Please note that no refunds will be issued for cancellations made for customer reasons.
However, if a restaurant initiates a cancellation, the system usage fee for that reservation will be refunded.
